name: frontend-development
description: Build responsive, accessible, performant OddlyFound UI following existing project conventions.
---
# Frontend Development
- Initialize Caveman first.
- Inspect framework, components, styles, routes, content model, and conventions before coding.
- Prefer semantic HTML, accessible controls, keyboard support, and visible focus states.
- Test mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts where relevant.
- Minimize client JavaScript; prefer Astro/static rendering where appropriate.
- Preserve existing patterns unless the approved request requires a change.
- Handle relevant loading, empty, error, and success states.
- Use real navigation destinations, never fake links or inert controls.
- Use meaningful alt text for informative images and empty alt for decorative images.
- Make affiliate CTAs understandable and disclosures visible where required.
- Do not assume permission to reuse third-party assets, copy, logos, or prices.
- Consider metadata, canonical URLs, heading hierarchy, social metadata, and accurate structured data.
- Report checks actually run. Implement only after Gate A and Gate B.
